title: fix(plugin-auth): a browser refused at /oauth2/authorize by the environment-access gate gets access_denied at its client, or a readable page, not raw JSON
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D58H4hn7mx9bRShF3BfEhTw)_

Part of #32992 — the server half. The environment-side half (the Console sign-in page's sentence and actions for a returned `access_denied`) is still open; see Acceptance notes.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：环境访问门（D5.1）在 `/oauth2/authorize` 拒绝一个已登录账号时，按调用方区分回答：浏览器直接打开的页面，若 `redirect_uri` 是该客户端注册过的（逐字相同），就 302 带 `error=access_denied`、`error_description`、原 `state`、`iss` 回到环境；没有可信的 `redirect_uri` 时给一个可读的 403 HTML 页（写明当前账号、"Switch account"、"Back to console"）；其余调用方（Console 登录后的 fetch、API 客户端、curl）仍是原来的 403 `ENV_ACCESS_DENIED` JSON，一个字节不变。
- **为什么改**：非成员账号登录后，浏览器被带回授权地址，整页显示一段原始 JSON，没有原因也没有下一步。
- **风险与回滚**：只动"拒绝之后怎么回答"，拒绝与否不变；未注册的 `redirect_uri` 永不跟随（只认与注册值逐字相同的，比 provider 自己的规则更窄）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-authorize-refusal.ts` 的 `registeredRedirect`（决定跟不跟随的地方）；`auth-manager-before-hook.ts` 的 D5.1 分支；`oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/oauth-authorize-refusal.ts`: `answerRefusedAuthorization` decides how a refusal by the D5.1 gate is delivered.
  - Not a page navigation (`isPageNavigation`, the predicate the mobile sign-in hand-off already uses): throws the same `403` envelope as before, `code: ENV_ACCESS_DENIED`, same message.
  - A page navigation whose `redirect_uri` the provider would also deliver an error to: `302` to it with `error=access_denied`, `error_description`, the original `state` and `iss` (RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1, RFC 9207), `Cache-Control: no-store`, no code.
  - A page navigation with no such `redirect_uri`: `403` `text/html` page naming the signed-in account, with "Switch account" (the provider's own `/oauth2/end-session`) and "Back to console" (`getConsolePageUrl('/')`), under a `default-src 'none'` CSP.
- `auth-manager-before-hook.ts`: the D5.1 branch returns that answer instead of throwing; `BeforeHookHost` gains `getConsolePageUrl`.
- `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`: one line, the host literal passes `getConsolePageUrl` through (the member `AuthInstanceHost` already carries).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch.

**Which `redirect_uri` is followed.** The provider's own validator (`resolveTrustedRedirectUri` in `@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.12) is module-private: none of the package's four entries (`.`, `./client`, `./resource-client`, `./internal`) exports it, so it cannot be called. What is reused is the provider's client loader (`getOAuthProviderApi(ctx, opts).getClient`, the read its authorize endpoint makes) and `getIssuer`. On that read the module follows a URI only when the provider would also deliver an error there, and only in the strictest form of its rule: `GET`, `response_type=code`, no `request`/`request_uri`; client found, not disabled, allowed the `authorization_code` grant; the requested URI equal to a registered one string for string (the provider also accepts a loopback URI on another port, which gets the page here); and a configured custom `validateRedirectUri` must accept it too. Anything else, including any failure reading the client, gets the page.

## Why

A user who signed out of an environment and signed in as an account outside its organization was sent back to `/oauth2/authorize` by the Console's post-sign-in fallback (a top-level navigation after its `fetch` got the `403`) and saw `{"message":"You are not authorized to sign in to this environment.","code":"ENV_ACCESS_DENIED"}` as the page. The refusal is right; the presentation to a browser was not.

## Verification

Readings on head `e79a022e0` unless stated. The final head `b6957df80` changes only the new test file (it restores the `console.error` mock and drops two unneeded lint directives); on it, `src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts` → `Tests 11 passed (11)` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` → exit 0, and the test-reading gates `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:test-source-alias` → exit 0.

<details><summary>New pins: oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts (real AuthManager, real better-auth 1.7.12 + oauth-provider, real before-hook, in-memory engine)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/oauth-authorize-refusal.test.ts` → `Tests 11 passed (11)`.

- registered `redirect_uri` + navigation → 302 with `error=access_denied`, `error_description`, `state` (a value with `&`, space, `/`, `?`, `#`, `é`) and `iss`; no `code`; gate called once with the caller.
- control: the same request with an allowing gate → 302 with `code`.
- navigation with an unregistered URI, a loopback URI on another port, a disabled client, no `redirect_uri` → 403 HTML, no `Location`, the account's email, both action links; the attacker URI appears nowhere in the page.
- "Switch account" link followed → the provider's `Confirm logout` page (200 HTML).
- Console fetch (`Accept: application/json`), JSON without Fetch Metadata, `*/*` → 403 `ENV_ACCESS_DENIED` envelope, no `Location`.
- anonymous navigation → the gate never runs; 302 to the Console login page.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per arm; fix committed first, restore proven by blob hash = HEAD and an empty working-tree diff)</summary>

Driven with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit x1 → x0, on-disk counts printed by the tool). Tests import `src/` directly, so no build sits between the mutation and the run.

- redirect arm (`if (back)` → `if (false && back)`): 1 failed (the 302 pin).
- exact-match guard deleted: 3 failed (unregistered URI, loopback port variant, the switch-account pin that reads the page).
- HTML arm answers the JSON envelope instead: 5 failed (all four page cases + switch account).
- JSON arm (`!isPageNavigation(...)` → `false`): 3 failed (all three envelope callers).
- The anonymous fall-through is not changed by this diff, so it is pinned but not ablated.
</details>

<details><summary>Package checks</summary>

- Dependency closure: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@objectstack/plugin-auth^...' build` → exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck`) → exit 0; `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` → `Test Files 270 passed (270)`, `Tests 5125 passed | 10 skipped (5135)`; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 68 derived; `--ran` reconciliation: 67 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it reads every package's `dist/` and this worktree built only the plugin-auth closure; CI runs it on a full build).
- The dogfood pin `oidc-authorize-env-gate.dogfood.test.ts` sends no HTML `Accept` and no Fetch Metadata, so it stays on the unchanged envelope arm; it runs in CI.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Remaining half of #32992 (this repository, not cloud).** After the redirect, the environment's own Console sign-in page (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/ssoCallbackRefusal.ts`) renders `?error=access_denied` with the generic sentence "Single sign-on could not be completed — the sign-in link expired or was already used", with `access_denied: You are not authorized to sign in to this environment.` behind Technical details. It needs its own sentence and a switch-account action; that is a `ui/` change with eleven locale bundles, outside this PR's file surface. Hence `Part of`.
- No hand-written docs page states the D5.1 gate (only ADR-0069 and the generated error-code ledger), so no docs page changed.
- "Switch account" on the page uses the provider's own RP-initiated logout; after it, the user returns to the environment and signs in again. A switch that returns straight into the authorization request needs the environment half above.
